items.author: Joe Hudson
items.text: Business is one of the best self-development practices that I have ever encountered. To make it a great practice, don't just ask, "How do I be successful?" Also ask, "How do I do business in a way that feels great inside?"

items.author: Tim Denning
items.text:
I’m in love with this sentence:

“The reason you want it so badly is because the version of you in the future already has it.”

items.author: Paul Millerd
items.text:
dinner parties are underrated especially for parents.

I realized that its just too hard to go out at night so started organizing dinners at my house, arrive at 5, eating at 5:30 - start putting kids to bed at 7:30 

people love being invited to stuff, doesnt matter what you cook

items.author: Yun-Ta Tsai
items.text:
"At some point, everything's gonna go south on you... and you're gonna say, this is it. This is how I end. Now, you can either accept that, or you can get to work. That's all it is. You just begin. You do the math. You solve one problem... and you solve the next one... and then the next. And if you solve enough problems, you get to come home."

— “The Martian”
